import itertools

def is_all_interval_series(p):
    n = len(p)
    diffs = [abs(p[i+1] - p[i]) for i in range(n-1)]
    return sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, n))

n = 4
perms = itertools.permutations(range(n))
solutions = [p for p in perms if is_all_interval_series(p)]
print(solutions)
